headerDisplay: Publishes a SPAN panel to Apple Home as Matter energy devices. **Matter must be enabled for the bridge this plugin runs on** (Homebridge 2.4+, a child bridge is recommended). On first start, open the panel door and press the door switch 3 times, or enter the panel passphrase below.

host.title: Panel address
host.description: The panel's .local name or IP address.

hopPassphrase.title: Panel passphrase (optional)
hopPassphrase.description: Registers without the door switch. Leave empty to register by pressing the door switch 3 times.

allowRelayControl.title: Let the Home app switch circuit relays
allowRelayControl.description: Outlet mode only. Off: taps on a circuit are undone. On: a tap opens or closes the breaker's relay, so the circuit loses power.

include.title: Only these circuits
include.description: Leave empty to publish every circuit. Every device adds work for every Apple device in the home, so list just the circuits you watch on a busy panel. Solar and battery are always published.

oneOf.title: Only when they have carried energy

wholeHomeMeter.title: Whole-home meter (when a battery gateway feeds the panel)
wholeHomeMeter.description: Apple Home's "All Home" figure follows this device. Utility: net grid import/export, energy integrated from power. Panel: everything drawn through the panel, from its own counters.

batteryMode.title: Show the battery as
batteryMode.description: Sensor: a tile with the charge level, which Apple Home labels Not Supported (turn off battery level to drop both). Outlet: a supported tile with live power and charge level, whose switch does nothing.

publishIntervalSeconds.title: Send changes to Apple Home every (seconds)
publishIntervalSeconds.description: Changes go out in one batch this often. Every batch makes each Apple device in the home reload the whole bridge, so short intervals cost a lot. Relay switches go out at once.

powerDeadbandPercent.title: Or smaller than this share of the reading (%)
powerDeadbandPercent.description: Whichever is larger applies. Smaller changes still go out within a minute.
